Abstract:   | This work presents results in the context of (unitary) easy quantum groups. These are compact matrix quantum groups featuring a rich combinatorial structure given by partitions (of sets). This thesis reports on three topics within this area. Topic 1: Linear independence of the intertwiner maps Tp in the free case: Given a suitable collection of partitions p, there exists by definition a connection to easy quantum groups via intertwiner maps Tp. A sufficient condition for this correspondence to be one-to-one are particular linear independences on the level of maps Tp. In the case of non-crossing partitions, a proof of this linear independence can be traced down to a matrix determinant formula, developed by W. Deren Elemente sind Tupel von Quantenvektoren, angelehnt an die ersten d Spalten der Quantenmatrizen in G. Wir definieren jedoch diese Quantenräume als universelle C -Algebren, zunächst ohne direkten Bezug zu diesen Quantenmatrizen. Das Hauptresultat ist die Rekonstruktion der easy Quantengruppe G aus dem Quantenraum X als dessen Quantensymmetriegruppe QSymG(X), zumindest für hinreichend große Spaltenzahl d. Im Falle nicht-kreuzender Partitionen wird gezeigt, dass der kleinstm ögliche Wert für d, der diese Rekonstruktion erlaubt, entweder eins oder zwei ist.

**D5, D6, D7: PASS without repairs.** Fix `0<c0<E-nr`, `a_p²=c0/[p(1-p)]` in the first real mode, and mix displaced tau_x with weights 1−p,p and displacements −p a_p,(1−p)a_p. The weighted mean is exactly zero and the displacement-energy contribution exactly c0. The state is faithful, with energy `nx+c0`. Its entropy is `ng(x)+chi_in`, an exact finite binary Holevo formula.

For heterodyne measurement, the first real-coordinate variance is `(x+1)/2`; the midpoint threshold, although not necessarily the optimal decision rule for unequal priors, has both conditional errors at most `exp[-a_p²/(4(x+1))]`. Thus its total error has the same upper bound. For small p it is below 1/2, so monotonicity of binary entropy, binary Fano and classical measurement data processing give D6 uniformly for x in `[r/2,r]`. Under the actual physical channel the component temperature is `s_x=eta x+(1-eta)b`, separation `sqrt(eta)a_p`; the same argument gives D7 with exponent `eta c0/[4(s+1)p(1-p)]`. This is a quantum Holevo lower bound obtained from a specified measurement, not a classical replacement of quantum entropy.

**Exact entropy repair and D8: PASS without repairs.** For each fixed p, entropy is continuous in x under a common finite-energy bound. At r the Holevo information is strictly positive, since its vanishing forces both distinct displaced components equal to their mixture. At r/2, the binary entropy upper bound makes the entropy strictly below H for small p. The intermediate-value root x_p is consequently actual and lies in `(r/2,r)`. It preserves centering, faithfulness, exact entropy H, and energy `<nr+c0<E`.
